s.note: Cheddar crackers cut into letters, for the day E.T. learns English
s.how: Pulse 150g grated cheddar, 60g cold butter and 100g flour with salt until it forms a dough, adding a splash of water. Roll thin and cut into letters with small cutters. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp.

s.n: Halloween caramel popcorn and lolly mix
s.note: Oven-baked caramel popcorn tossed with chocolate buttons, jelly lollies and roasted peanuts, piled up like a trick or treat haul
s.how: Heat the oven to 120°C. Pop the corn and tip it into a large roasting tray. Melt the butter with the brown sugar and golden syrup, boil for 4 minutes, then stir in the bicarb and a pinch of salt. Pour over the popcorn and toss well. Bake for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool, break up and toss with the chocolate buttons, jelly lollies and peanuts.

m.note: Pepperoni pizza in squares, as Michael's friends wait on the pizza man
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce and top with 250g mozzarella and 100g pepperoni. Bake on a steel or tray at the oven's highest heat for 7 to 8 minutes, then cut into squares.

w.note: Elliott fakes sick to stay home with E.T. Milk chocolate and peanut butter cups
w.how: Melt 300g milk chocolate. Spoon a little into 12 cupcake liners and chill. Mix 150g peanut butter with 50g icing sugar and put a spoon on each. Cover with the rest of the chocolate and chill until set.

w.note: Peanut butter discs in candy melts, like Reese's Pieces
w.how: Beat 200g peanut butter with 100g icing sugar and 30g soft butter. Roll into small discs and chill 30 minutes. Dip in 250g melted coloured candy melts and set on baking paper. Lay them in a trail across the table.

d.note: E.T. raids the fridge while Elliott's at school. Root beer, vanilla ice cream, chocolate
d.how: Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes. Add 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream to each glass. Slowly pour 250ml cold root beer down the side of each glass so the foam rises without spilling over. Top with a drizzle of chocolate syrup and serve straight away with long spoons and straws.
